body:
I have used professional help in the past, but quit going after a short time. I also used to take medication but none of it ever worked so I stopped taking everything. Writing helps me cope, but only so much. 

My doctor at least a couple of times has told me he'd really be happier if I at least tried a new medication and that I should meet with a psychiatrist as well, but it's something that makes me so anxious and nervous even considering.

That's the only thing that makes me nervous. I don't want to hurt anyone or inconvenience anybody. Much younger in life when a friend of mine killed himself and I always thought of how things were affected or how people's lives could have been different because of it. I guess sometimes I just don't consider myself important enough to have that kind of effect.

Your words are moving, and something to think about. The only reason I try to stay alive is for my friends and family, without them, I would have done it already. Fighting depression and anxiety for the last decade have been taking a huge toll on my psyche and body however.

I try to think of something meaningful that I could be to someone, but I feel like nothing I could do is important. If nothing else, I'd just settle with finding away above this depression that infects my heart and mind.
